title: Book 5 — Terpsichore, Chapter 26
paragraphs: This Otanes, then, who was made to sit in that seat, had now become the successor of Megabazus in the command; and he conquered the Byzantians and Calchedonians, and conquered Antandrus in the land of Troas, and Lamponium; and having received ships from the Lesbians, he conquered Lemnos and Imbros, which were both at that time still inhabited by Pelasgians.
